run_calculate_primes: run the multiprocessing gRPC client to check primality of integers up to 10000 against a server
initialize_worker_channel: initialize a gRPC insecure channel and PrimeCheckerStub for a worker process given a server address
run_worker_query: run a single primality check RPC request for a candidate number using the worker stub
shutdown_worker_channel: shutdown the worker process gRPC channel and log the shutdown message
review_main_entry: review the main entry point that parses a server address argument and prints prime results
